reviews.x: A dermatologist wrote me a prescription for this lotion and my co-pay was $35.  I got to thinking about it, looked on Amazon and sure enough.....MUCH less money and MUCH easier to get!  Works great, especially for diabetic feet!

reviews.t: Recommended by my podiatrist for my cracked heels
reviews.x: I have severely dry and cracked heels. I went to a podiatrist and he recommended this lotion to me. He said that he could have given me a prescription but I would be able to find the lotion cheaper online. Sure enough. It's been over 3 years since I first purchased this lotion and it works amazingly. I put a little bit of this on my heel and then put on my socks and leave it like that all day. The lotion makes my feet so soft and it keeps my skin from cracking.
I definitely prefer this version over LacHydrin and AmLactin.  It packs more of a tingle, absorbs more quickly, and leaves me feeling more moisturized.

reviews.t: Give it a month or so - great for KP (Keratosis Pilaris)
reviews.x: I wanted to get something to get rid of my KP which I have suffered from for over a decade. I've been told mine is especially bas as it's reached every inch of my body except my face and neck, though it's beginning to creep up there. I used it for a month, along with showering more often (daily rather than every other day), exfoliating, and I applied the lotion once daily. reviews.t: The best lotion I’ve ever tried hands down
reviews.x: I’ve always struggled with ingrown hairs, clogged pores, dry, flaky and scaly skin all over my body I thought it was kp and tried glycolic acid, salicylic acid, manual exfoliation moisturizing with all kinds of lotions including some with hyaluronic acid and nothing gave me the results that this lotion gave me. Even with one use my skin is drastically more smooth. After a week using it on freshly shaved skin my skin went from bumpy irritated and dry to smooth almost bump free and no irritation.

I use this twice a day and barley get them now. I did stop for awhile after having surgery and they started coming back so I'm back on it. It works well even without covering my hands with socks. I like that it is not too greasy at all, and it instantly moisturizes my hands, and keeps them looking moisturized, unlike other lotions I’ve used, that tend to make my Hands worse. I am glad this product works for me!

All is gone… Skin feels great

claims.text: Many reviewers say it works well for very dry, cracked, or calloused skin, especially on feet and heels.
Several reviewers report it was recommended by a dermatologist or podiatrist, often as a cheaper alternative to a prescription.
Multiple reviewers say it helps with keratosis pilaris and bumpy skin.
A few reviewers mention it can sting or tingle, including one with sensitive skin who found it stung immediately.
One reviewer complained the bottle arrived only half full.
